description: This is a PHP test fixture class for setting up and tearing down LDAP directory entries related to users, groups, and organizational units used in LDAP authentication testing within the OrangeHRM project. The class provides methods to create, delete, and manage LDAP entries for various organizational units and user groups, primarily used for testing LDAP integrations.

classes.name: LDAPUsersFixture
classes.description: A fixture class used in LDAP authentication testing for setting up and cleaning LDAP directory structures: organizational units, user entries, and groups, by interfacing with a provided LDAP adapter.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Initialize LDAP directory structure with organizational units, users, and groups for testing purposes.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Remove all created LDAP entries and organizational units to clean up after tests.

methods.name: searchAndDelete
methods.description: Search LDAP directory for entries matching the specified distinguished name and query, then delete them.

methods.name: removeEntity
methods.description: Remove a given LDAP entry object from the directory.

methods.name: tryWrapper
methods.description: Execute a closure with LDAP exception handling.

methods.name: createRootOrgUnits
methods.description: Create base organizational units in LDAP directory if they do not exist.

methods.name: deleteRootOrgUnits
methods.description: Remove the base organizational units and their contained entries.

methods.name: createAdminOrgUnit
methods.description: Create LDAP organizational units and user entries for admin users.

methods.name: deleteAdminOrgUnit
methods.description: Delete LDAP organizational units and user entries for admin users.

methods.name: createSalesOrgUnit
methods.description: Create LDAP organizational units and user entries related to sales and marketing functions.

methods.name: deleteSalesOrgUnit
methods.description: Delete LDAP organizational units and user entries related to sales and marketing.

methods.name: createLegalOrgUnit
methods.description: Create a legal organizational unit in LDAP.

methods.name: deleteLegalOrgUnit
methods.description: Delete the legal organizational unit.

methods.name: createEngineeringOrgUnit
methods.description: Create LDAP organizational units and user entries for engineering, including developers, managers, and QA teams.

methods.name: deleteEngineeringOrgUnit
methods.description: Delete LDAP organizational units and user entries for engineering.

methods.name: createFinanceOrgUnit
methods.description: Create LDAP organizational unit and user entries for finance department.

methods.name: deleteFinanceOrgUnit
methods.description: Delete the finance organizational unit and its user entries.

methods.name: createAdminsGroup
methods.description: Create LDAP group for admins.

methods.name: deleteAdminsGroup
methods.description: Delete LDAP admin group.

methods.name: createManagersGroup
methods.description: Create LDAP group for managers.

methods.name: deleteManagersGroup
methods.description: Delete LDAP managers group.

methods.name: createEmployeesGroup
methods.description: Create LDAP group for employees within engineering.

methods.name: deleteEmployeesGroup
methods.description: Delete LDAP employees group.
